# MobiSIM

**Author:** X-MaSS-X; build — Krolik<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![MobiSIM: screenshot 1](./mobisim/img/mobisim.png)

</div>

MobiSIM works with flash memory, SKey and master keys, EEPROM, IMEI, and contrast settings on Siemens phones based on the EGOLD platform. It switches the phone to service and normal modes, displays phone information, clears file system partitions, and emulates a SIM card.
